title: oreophysa triphylla
intro: Oreophysa triphylla, commonly known as Himalayan fleabane, is a flowering plant native to the Himalayan region and parts of Asia. The plant is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which may help to reduce pain and improve overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Oreophysa triphylla include its ability to act as an antipyretic, antibacterial, and antifungal agent, making it useful for treating various infections and fever. The bioactive constituents of the plant include sesquiterpenes and flavonoids, which contribute to its therapeutic properties and potential health benefits.
